[[File:Magnus XY028.png|thumb|250px|Magnus]] '''Magnus''' (Japanese: '''モーガン''' ''Morgan'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY028|The Bonds of Evolution!]]''. He comes from [[Brackish Town]]. Following his title as "last year's best from Brackish Town", Magnus was given the opportunity to compete in an {{wp|Exhibition game|exhibition match}} against the [[Kalos]] {{pkmn|Champion}} [[Diantha]]. He sent out his {{p|Absol}} to battle [[Diantha's Gardevoir]], but it was easily defeated without Absol scoring a hit on Gardevoir. After the battle, Magnus respectfully shook hands with Diantha. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Magnus |pkmn=Absol |type1=Dark |img=Magnus Absol.png |epnum=XY028 |epname=The Bonds of Evolution! |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc={{p|Absol}} is Magnus's only known Pokémon. It was sent out to battle [[Diantha's Gardevoir]]. Absol started the battle with Bite, which Gardevoir quickly dodged. Though it tried to use Perish Song on its opponent, Absol was defeated with {{m|Moonblast}}, losing Magnus the battle. Absol's known moves are {{m|Bite}}, {{m|Quick Attack}}, {{m|Psycho Cut}}, and {{m|Perish Song}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{dark color}}|bordercolor={{dark color light}} |ja=最上嗣生 ''[[Tsuguo Mogami]]'' |en=Bruce Warren |fi=Pasi Ruohonen |fr_eu=Jean-Marc Delhausse |it=Patrizio Prata |es_eu=Alfonso González}}
